reviewScope.defaultScope: Each named matrix as a whole lookup table, including axes and all cells. Qualifier passages are reviewed as separate linked source units. This does not claim any particular cell as a standalone fact or extend to the excluded I.B matrix or the rest of the book.

authorComparison.method: Independently compared blind table IDs and armor-class axes; aligned each author attacker band by printed label and level min/max; compared every integer target value by armor class; then compared band markers and qualifier text.
qualifierFindings: I.C asterisk appears on the missile adjustment line and its “Normal, not magical.” qualifier; it does not qualify the matrix cells.
I.D.1 markers and notes align: a/b/c/d/d/d across six level bands; the four notes specify double/triple/quadruple/quintuple surprise back-stab damage, with d applying to the last three bands.
authorComparison.pixelAdjudication: No cell, band, marker, or qualifier mismatch was found; there were no disputed coordinates requiring further pixel adjudication. The blind values had been transcribed from the original source page pixels before opening the author proposal.

cropAndFocusReview.title: I.A. Attack Matrix for Clerics, Druids and Monks
cropAndFocusReview.observed: Crop shows heading, complete seven-band lookup table with all 21 AC rows, and complete missile adjustment. Table focus separates the whole table from the missile line.
cropAndFocusReview.focusFinding: The missile-note focus box starts at y=278; in the 216-dpi source crop, note ink begins above that edge and the overlay top border visibly intersects the upper ink. The source crop itself does not clip the note. This is an overlay-margin issue, not a transcription or source-crop defect.
cropAndFocusReview.status: Crop complete; v2 focus needs the conservative top-margin expansion shown above.

cropAndFocusReview.title: I.C. Attack Matrix for Magic-Users and Illusionists
cropAndFocusReview.observed: Crop includes heading, full five-band lookup table with all 21 AC rows, missile adjustment, and “Normal, not magical.” qualifier. It reaches the physical right CropBox edge without cutting the gray table margin; bottom ends after the qualifier and before adjacent artwork.
cropAndFocusReview.focusFinding: Whole-table axes and cells are focused; the missile line and qualifier have separate focus boxes and their full glyphs are inside. The table focus extends to x=571, however, which includes the outer right page-edge artifact beyond the gray table end; narrowing the table focus to the content end near x=550 would remove this irrelevant highlight. The crop should continue to the physical CropBox edge.
cropAndFocusReview.status: Crop content complete; focus needs its right edge narrowed to exclude the outer page-edge artifact.

cropAndFocusReview.title: I.D.1. Attack Matrix for Thieves and Assassins
cropAndFocusReview.observed: Crop includes heading, all six marked bands and 21 AC rows, complete missile line, and all four back-stab notes. It reaches the physical right CropBox edge; table gray margins and rightmost values remain visible.
cropAndFocusReview.focusFinding: The table and all linked passages are present in the crop. The table focus extends to x=571 and includes the outer right page-edge artifact beyond the gray table end; the first-to-last note focus boxes start at x=290, where overlay pixels visibly cut the left edge of the superscript/bullet markers a, b, c and d. The crop contains those markers intact. This is a focus-coverage/relevance issue, not a source-crop defect.
cropAndFocusReview.status: Crop content complete; focus needs its table right edge narrowed and note/range left edge widened.
